items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: He was a blues player. Herschel and I were friends.

ctx.x: He was a blues player. Herschel and I were friends. And Herschel...women liked him, you know...so he always had two or three women following him around, so after the show one night we went to this after-hours club and when we got into this after-hours club, he tried to show me up by telling everybody how great a piano player he was, and that I couldn't play and this.
